entities.name: Frederick de la Roche
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frederick of La Roche was the sixth Latin archbishop of Tyre (1164–1174), chancellor of the kingdom of Jerusalem, and the chief diplomat of King Amalric. He was a Lorrainer, from the family of the counts of La Roche.
